verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents identity brokering with existing OpenID Connect and SAML 2.0 identity providers, configured through the admin console with no application changes (keycloak-docs-9, keycloak-docs-46, kc-supp-social-brokering), plus account linking across providers (keycloak-docs-25). Community users report many external IdPs integrated for SSO in clustered production (keycloak-comm-1), and say Google SSO took only a few settings (keycloak-comm-16). Missing for 10: vendor-specific setup documentation or hands-on reports for Okta and Entra ID, and in-depth first-party brokering configuration docs (evidence is mostly homepage-level claims).
